test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Hand and glove
solution:
The correct answer is __**Very intimate terms**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An idiom is a collection of words established by usage as having a meaning distinct from the meanings of the individual words
 
• The idiom **hand and glove** means in extremely close relationship or agreement .
 
• *Example *: The general manager at the Scottish plant, will work **hand in glove** with UK managing director in London.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Some more idioms related to **hands **are :

 
• **Change hands** - to be sold or taken over by someone else.

*Example *: I can't believe he **change hands** just for money.

 
• **Give someone a hand **- to help someone with something.

*Example *: My mother came to** give me a hand.**

 
• **Get out of hand** - getting out of control.

*Example *: Young children are** getting out of hands** of parents.
